;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Post-civil war violence in Libya]]
**The [[Libyan National Army]] fights with rebels occupying oil ports near [[Benghazi]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/03/22/us-libya-oil-fighting-idUSBREA2L06020140322 (Reuters)]
*[[2014 Crimean crisis]]
**Russian troops capture [[Novofedorivka]], an airbase of the [[Ukrainian Navy]] in the western region of the [[Crimean Peninsula]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-26698754 (BBC News)]

;Business and economy
*A member of the governing council of the [[European Central Bank]] says that the ECB may yet cut [[interest rates]] still further, into negative territory. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/03/22/us-ecb-liikanen-rates-idUSBREA2L05H20140322 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Five people die after a light plane catches fire on take-off at [[Caboolture Airport]] in [[Queensland]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2014/mar/22/six-feared-dead-as-skydiver-plane-crashes (''The Guardian'')]
*At least 35 people die in [[Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]], in a collision between a petrol tanker and two buses. [http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/35-killed-in-road-accident-in-southwest-pakistan-114032200158_1.html (PTI via ''Business Standard'')]
*[[2014 Oso mudslide]]:
**A landslide kills two people, and injures six in [[Oso, Washington|Oso]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], [[United States]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2014/03/22/us/washington-landslide/index.html?hpt=hp_t2 (CNN)]
*[[Galveston Bay#Pollution|2014 Galveston Bay fuel oil spill]]:
**A barge carrying nearly a million gallons of oil collides with a ship in [[Galveston Bay]] on the coast of the US state of [[Texas]] causing an oil spill. [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/barge-leaking-oil-galveston-bay-after-collision (AP)]

;International relations
*The [[Veneto]] region votes to secede from [[Italy]] in  an [[Venice referendum, 2014|informal online referendum]]. [http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-2586531/Venice-votes-split-Italy-89-citys-residents-opt-form-new-independent-state.html (''The Daily Mail'')]

;Sports
*[[Major League Baseball]] starts its [[2014 Major League Baseball season|2014 season]] at the [[Sydney Cricket Ground]] in [[Australia]]. The [[Los Angeles Dodgers]] defeat the [[Arizona Diamondbacks]] by a score of 3&ndash;1. [http://scores.espn.go.com/mlb/recap?gameId=340322129 (AP via ESPN)]
